features.name: Foundation: Powerhouse
features.description: Increase the d8 damage dice for your unarmed attack to d10s. Additionally, you can mark a Stress to target two creatures within Melee range with a single attack roll.

features.name: Foundation: Overwhelm
features.description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Hope to force the target to mark a Stress or to throw them within Close range.

features.name: Specialization: Rugged
features.description: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your Severe damage threshold. Additionally, your Powerhouse feature can target up to three creatures instead of two.

features.name: Specialization: Eye for an Eye
features.description: When you mark more than one Hit Point from an attack in Melee range, the attacker must make a Reaction Roll (13). On a failure, once per rest, they immediately mark the same number of Hit Points in return.

features.name: Mastery: Pummeljoy
features.description: When you critically succeed on a weapon attack in Melee range, you gain an additional Hope, clear an additional Stress, and gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the attack.

features.name: Mastery: Not Done Yet
features.description: When you mark more than one HP from an attack, you can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
